title: A Sub-4 Approximation for Fair $k$-Means
abstract: arXiv:2609.07974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fairness in clustering has attracted sustained research interest, motivated by the need to ensure equitable representation of protected groups in machine learning applications. We study fair $k$-means clustering in Euclidean space, where the proportion of each protected group in every cluster must lie within specified lower and upper bounds. These constraints make it challenging to determine both cluster centers and point assignments. We propose an approximation algorithm that combines a linear programming relaxation with geometric transformations of the input to construct candidate center sets. Given a $\rho$-approximate algorithm for weighted $k$-means and any $\epsilon>0$, our algorithm returns a fractional solution whose cost is at most $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$ times the optimal integral fair cost, where $\Gamma\approx6.357$ is an upper bound on the integrality gap of the standard Euclidean $k$-means LP. translated_title: 公平 $k$-均值聚类的次4倍近似算法
translated_abstract: 聚类中的公平性吸引了持续的研究关注，其动机在于需要确保受保护群体在机器学习应用中的公平代表性。我们研究欧几里得空间中的公平 $k$-均值聚类问题，其中每个受保护群体在每个簇中所占的比例必须位于指定的下界与上界之间。这些约束使得同时确定簇中心和点的分配变得极具挑战性。我们提出了一种近似算法，该算法将线性规划松弛与对输入数据的几何变换相结合来构造候选中心集合。给定一个加权 $k$-均值问题的 $\rho$-近似算法以及任意 $\epsilon>0$，我们的算法返回一个分数解，其成本至多为最优整数公平成本的 $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$ 倍，其中 $\Gamma\approx6.357$ 是标准欧几里得 $k$-均值线性规划整数间隙的上界。当使用 PTAS 作为……
tldr: 本文针对公平 $k$-均值聚类问题提出了首个次4倍近似算法，通过将线性规划松弛与几何变换相结合构造候选中心集合，实现了 $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$ 的近似比。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first sub-4 approximation algorithm for fair $k$-means clustering, which combines linear programming relaxation with geometric transformations of the input to construct candidate center sets, achieving an approximation ratio of $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$.
